data.content_ref: inline:The problem asks for the SINGLE mechanism that best explains why the night-time UHI gap is larger in some cities than in others. SRC_001 answers this with a cross-city driver that is explicitly an interaction of two co-occurring factors—building height AND thermal mass—and states that 'neither mechanism alone is sufficient,' so the explanation is irreducibly two-factor. The problem presupposes a single best mechanism, so a target whose stated answer is a non-decomposable interaction of two factors does not give the requested single mechanism and therefore fails the problem as stated.
